about.title: A small boutique with big ideas
about.text1: At Mini Nube we choose every piece thinking about kids' comfort and families' peace of mind. We work with soft fabrics, safe dyes and designs that survive a thousand adventures.
about.text2: We were born in the neighbourhood market and we are still that friendly corner where you can touch, try on and get advice.

about.alt2: Two girls lying on the grass

info.cookies:
We use essential technical cookies to remember your cart, your language and light or dark mode. This data is stored only in your browser (local storage).

We do not use advertising or tracking cookies without your consent. You can delete the data at any time from your browser settings.
info.requirements:
• Online purchases are available to customers over 18.
• Prices include VAT. Shipping costs €4.90 and is free over €60.
• Market pickup is Monday to Saturday in the chosen time slot; we hold your order for 3 days.
• You can pay on pickup, on delivery or through a secure payment gateway.
• Please provide real contact details so we can notify you of any issue.
info.returns:
You have 14 calendar days from receipt to exchange or return your items. They must be unworn, with tags and in their original packaging.

You can bring them to the market stall or write to hola@mininube.es to arrange a collection. Refunds are made using the original payment method.
